sn22.156:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa Attānudiṭṭhi uppajjatīti || || Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || pe || || Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa attānudiṭṭhi uppajjati || || Vedanāya sati || Saññāya sati || Saṅkhāresu sati || Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa attānudiṭṭhi uppajjati || || Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || || Yam panāniccam || pa || api nu tam anupādāya attānudiṭṭhi uppajjeyyā ti || || No hetam bhante || || Vedanā || Saññā || {Saṅkhārā} || Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || || Yam panāniccam || pa || api nu tam anupādāya attānudiṭṭhi uppajjeyyāti || || No hetam bhante || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyā ti pajānātīti || || Sāvatthi || ||
